column18: Epistemic analysis of LTH and complexity regularization; theoretical, no experiments or efficiency figures.
Explains LTH and untrained random networks via random projection plus sparsification in MLPs; theoretical, no efficiency figures.
u-Ticket: up to 100% hardware utilization, 76.9% less latency, 63.8% less energy than non-utilization-aware LTH.
LTH draw-and-redraw of tiny MLP subnetworks for worst-case mechanism design; optimal mechanisms up to 5 agents; no efficiency metrics.
3D spiking transformer accelerator with MoE and head pruning; energy and latency gains over 2D CMOS claimed, no figures.
Abstract only reviews prior VAD work; no ANN-SNN efficiency comparison or pruning stated (title: 161 nW chip).
40 nm SNN processor with dynamic neuron pruning: 0.05-1.4 uJ/inference; no ANN baseline.
Hybrid SNN-ANN accelerator: 94.44% DVS Gesture, 6,711 inf/s, 5.9 uJ/inf; no ANN baseline or pruning.
Spiking policy for multi-AUV RL; reduced computational energy claimed vs other methods, no figures or ANN counterpart stated.
Hybrid ANN-SNN RL obstacle avoidance; energy efficiency on neuromorphic processor asserted, no figures or ANN comparison.
Review of digital and analog DNN vs SNN edge-AI circuits; trade-offs in energy (J/OP) and area; no figures.
Review of ANN pruning by granularity and timing, with extensive coverage of LTH; no efficiency figures.
CSSNN radar gesture recognition: 95.84% accuracy on 5-class TinyRadar, 127.1k MACs; no ANN comparison.
SSM on Loihi 2 vs Jetson Orin Nano: ~1000x energy efficiency, 75x latency and throughput; accuracy drop 1-3 points.
Demo: spiking vs conventional deep RL for RIS phase adaptation on energy, training latency, outage, BER; no figures.
Energy-aware dual-stage pruning for SNNs on CIFAR-10, CIFAR10-DVS, CIFAR-100; inference energy reduction claimed, no figures.
ANN-SNN conversion with negative spikes for Leaky ReLU models; abstract gives no energy, operation or latency figures.
Pruning, quantization and hybrid compression of SNNs on oceanographic data; competitive accuracy, smaller model size; no energy figures.
Hybrid CNN-SNN for histopathology: 75.33% accuracy on nine classes; efficiency only asserted, no figures.
Spiking hybrid model for multivariate time-series anomaly detection costs 5.04x lower energy than its ANN version.
SNN keyword-spotting chip, 65 nm: 94.63% accuracy (4-class GSCD), 7.7 uW, 18.74 ms/decision; DNN comparison on accuracy only.
LTR-LIF neuron with Adaptive Sparse Loss regulating firing rates; 96.25% CIFAR-10, 81.03% CIFAR-100, 60.33% Tiny-ImageNet; no energy figures.
Lightweight EEG motor-imagery SNN beats four CNN models in classification; energy efficiency asserted, no figures.
LTH during pre-training of masked autoencoder to select forgery-sensitive parameters for sparse fine-tuning; accuracy focus, no efficiency figures.
FPGA SNN accelerator, 8-bit weights, bitmap sparse weight encoding; energy gains claimed, no figures or ANN baseline.
